objective: Find an event-interface model method with independently verified advantage over strong cheap baselines on existing P1-P15 evidence, preserving testing / reusable response maps / repair narrative. Keep iterating without new experiments or Thor use.
constraints: No new flight, SITL, or Thor workloads
Keep every failed hypothesis and revision
Separate exploratory method search from held-out evidence
Use whole conditions / interventions / event combinations as holdouts
Match decision-time information and compare sufficiently strong inexpensive baselines
Do not claim a short-horizon prediction win completes the broader research objective
completion_requirements: Concrete core research problem justified across P1-P15
Executable model with explicit inputs, learned parameters, source-known structure and update rules
Explicit independent contribution of classical theory if retained; name alone insufficient
At least one nontrivial held-out independent advantage over cheap baselines, with errors and costs reported
Check transfer to both dropout and switching where existing data permits
Explain implications for testing, map reuse and repair, distinguish verified from proposed
Reproducible evidence and sensitivity / ablation audit without hidden outcome leakage
prior_rejections: P15 model search tied cheap baseline 4/8; map update no choice changes
Adjoint offline audit no independent ranking advantage
Whole-prefix state partition audit did not outperform cheap regression; local map improvements did not establish selection benefit

hypotheses.claim: A source-constrained intervention response model can predict the effect of completely held-out memory/reference treatments better than outcome lookup or feature regression; test immediate output and short transient first, then task effects.
falsifiers: uses post-intervention state unavailable to counterfactual prediction
gain disappears against direct cheap source features
only one-frame exact replay improves with no meaningful intervention decision advantage
hypotheses.evidence: h1_results.json: 36 P3 records. Whole N0/N2s treatment holdout source replay MAE .0133/.0155 vs numeric-state cheap regression .1174/.1020, but static previous-action difference MAE .0122/.0209; all D1/D2/D3 worst-choice and best-choice decisions matched by previous-only baseline. Does not complete objective.

hypotheses.claim: A physically structured response model can compose finite-amplitude intervention effects into cumulative height/tracking consequences with transferable error cancellation.
falsifiers: requires measured future commands or states at prediction time
simple impulse / kinematic feature baseline matches
hypotheses.evidence: Strict all-multievent exclusion from P11 parameter fitting:18 normal/single flights, P13 AB18 heldout. Source full-horizon task17/18 vs best lookup14/18 and state/ExtraTrees13/18. Complete-height MAE .08323m vs ExtraTrees .13123m, lookup .13154m. Mean complete-tilt error .811deg is slightly worse than ExtraTrees .756deg, but source misses1/7 witnessed tilt failures vs6/7 for that ExtraTrees model. Source picksF2-short vs cheapF4-long for continuous tilt; b3 measured lower bound50.849deg exceeds full45.884deg. Generic task-failure top1 yield tied3/3.66 archived inputs verified,2 future-outcome permutation checks. Original source-stage comparisons superseded by strict refit and accounting-aligned metrics.

hypotheses.claim: Predicting repair tradeoffs and admissible interventions is a better model use than repeatedly ranking obvious failures; source-aware repair transfer can beat fixed repair and cheap conditional rules on existing paired intervention data.
falsifiers: one fixed repair dominates every observed condition
improvement depends on invented retrospective constraints
no matched intervention outcomes support the claimed decision
hypotheses.evidence: P9 original report: C 9/9 and CR 8/8 both meet original task/cost requirements; fixed C remains a strong safe/low-tracking-cost rule. No independent selection gain established; do not invent new constraints.

hypotheses.claim: Information-directed single-event identification improves held-out composition maps more efficiently than repeatedly selecting high-risk cases.
hypotheses.evidence: 6 normal to6 normal+2 F1-A single-event records reduces untrained AB height MAE .54199 to .07558m. All6 possible single-condition updates give .07540-.08512m; D-opt .07558 vs cheap complete-trajectory-screen average .07571, no meaningful independent selection gain. Maximum-risk query .08512m with2 heightFP vs D-opt0. Keep transferable identification update, not D-optimal novelty.

hypotheses.claim: Integral angular-dynamics identification can recover transferable parameters from normal flights alone, avoiding extra single-event evidence.
hypotheses.evidence: Whole-flight CV on normal data selects64ms integration. Held P13 AB height MAE .601m, tilt MAE1.672deg, heightFP3; worse than derivative normal-only .542m. Normal-data fitting accuracy does not establish intervention extrapolation.

hypotheses.claim: Known nonlinear thrust-direction geometry improves unseen composition response prediction beyond equal-data local linearization and generic affine dynamics.
hypotheses.evidence: Identical18 single/normal trajectories, controller source, event logic, angular model. AB height MAE: physical .08323m, local force linearization .17730m, affine regression .12646m. HeightFP0 vs3 vs3; no domain exits. Classical structure has a concrete independently ablated role in the model.

retained_method.problem: Extract transferable information from full single-event trajectories to predict and update unmeasured event-combination response maps.
retained_method.model: Frozen actual GRU16/source clocks/history/target events + nonlinear rigid-body/4-filter execution model with10 identified effective coefficients.
retained_method.theory: Structured grey-box system identification with explicit nonlinear force geometry and shared parameters. D-optimal independent selection benefit not established.
retained_method.verified: Full-horizon strict composition holdout map advantage; cross-cell/shared-parameter update; a concrete stronger-tilt selection.
not_verified: Generic faster failure discovery versus best cheap baseline
